# Vehicle assets

Bundled locally; no third-party runtime requests or external textures. Original authored metre-scale geometry and rigid wheel pivots are retained.

- `row-crop-tractor.glb`: Row-crop Tractor, Arable Fields and Farm Machinery, 3DAssets.dev. Source: https://3dassets.dev/assets/arable-fields-and-farm-machinery-row-crop-tractor-eefceb01 . Immutable download: https://cdn.3dassets.dev/assets/16840/v1/model.glb . CC0 1.0 Universal.
- `county-pickup.glb`: Double-cab pickup with a bed canopy, Car Park and Road Vehicle Fleet, 3DAssets.dev. Source: https://3dassets.dev/assets/car-park-and-road-vehicle-fleet-double-cab-pickup-cano-aa92dedb . Immutable download: https://cdn.3dassets.dev/assets/32529/v1/model.glb . CC0 1.0 Universal.

License: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ . Attribution is not required. Both are generic vehicle designs. Only native wheel nodes are animated. The field cultivator, cargo, business buildings and chimney smoke are application-authored geometry/effects.
